name: nanos world - Latest
author: YuketsuSh@users.noreply.github.com
description: Pelican egg for the normal/public nanos world Dedicated Server. Uses the native Config.toml for packages, assets, game modes and advanced configuration, with a minimal upstream-compatible startup command.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

SRCDS_APPID="1936830"
INSTALL_DIR="/mnt/server"
STEAMCMD_DIR="${INSTALL_DIR}/steamcmd"

echo "=================================================="
echo " nanos world Dedicated Server - PUBLIC"
echo " Pelican Egg maintained by Yuketsu / YuketsuSh"
echo " Steam App ID: ${SRCDS_APPID}"
echo "=================================================="

apt-get update
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y \
    build-essential \
    wget \
    libstdc++6 \
    git \
    tar \
    ca-certificates \
    openssl \
    fontconfig \
    curl \
    lib32gcc-s1 \
    iproute2

mkdir -p "${INSTALL_DIR}" "${STEAMCMD_DIR}" "${INSTALL_DIR}/steamapps"

cd /tmp
curl -fsSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz \
    https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C "${STEAMCMD_DIR}"

export HOME="${INSTALL_DIR}"
cd "${STEAMCMD_DIR}"

# Keep the normal/public egg pinned to the public branch.
./steamcmd.sh \
    +force_install_dir "${INSTALL_DIR}" \
    +login anonymous \
    "+app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} -beta public" \
    validate \
    +quit

mkdir -p "${INSTALL_DIR}/.steam/sdk32" "${INSTALL_DIR}/.steam/sdk64"

if [[ -f "${STEAMCMD_DIR}/linux32/steamclient.so" ]]; then
    cp -f "${STEAMCMD_DIR}/linux32/steamclient.so" \
        "${INSTALL_DIR}/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so"
fi

if [[ -f "${STEAMCMD_DIR}/linux64/steamclient.so" ]]; then
    cp -f "${STEAMCMD_DIR}/linux64/steamclient.so" \
        "${INSTALL_DIR}/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so"
fi

if [[ ! -f "${INSTALL_DIR}/NanosWorldServer.sh" ]]; then
    echo "[FATAL] NanosWorldServer.sh was not installed by SteamCMD."
    exit 1
fi

chmod +x "${INSTALL_DIR}/NanosWorldServer.sh"
[[ -f "${INSTALL_DIR}/NanosWorldServer" ]] && chmod +x "${INSTALL_DIR}/NanosWorldServer"
[[ -f "${INSTALL_DIR}/NanosWorldServerTracy" ]] && chmod +x "${INSTALL_DIR}/NanosWorldServerTracy"

echo "=================================================="
echo " nanos world public server installed successfully."
echo " Packages/Assets/Game Mode are managed natively by Config.toml."
echo "=================================================="

variables.name: Announce
variables.description: Whether to announce the server in the nanos world server list.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum number of players connected simultaneously (1-999).

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: UDP query port. It must be different from the primary game port and must be added as a Pelican allocation.

variables.name: Dedicated Server
variables.description: 1 = dedicated server requiring reachable ports; 0 = P2P through Steam Datagram Relay.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: Initial nanos world map package. Other game configuration remains in Config.toml.
